## Observed problem

Describe the actual Codex session, failure, excessive workflow, regression, or safety gap.

## Expected behavior

State the proportional behavior that should have occurred.

## Evidence

Include relevant prompt shape, task tier, affected skill, commands, logs, or sanitized results.

## Proposed boundary

Explain the smallest change that solves the problem without weakening preservation, verification, or circuit breakers.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Clear trigger boundary
- [ ] Existing behavior protected
- [ ] Verification method defined
- [ ] Cost and context impact considered
- [ ] Privacy and external-service impact stated
